anomalies.observed: On the 'Capacitive Touch Button (TSC)' sheet, the TSC sampling capacitor C14 (connected between the TSC_G2_IO4 net and GND) is drawn with the value '22p' (22 pF).
anomalies.expected: The specification states C14 is the 22 nF TSC sampling capacitor ('TSC_G2_IO4: U2 pin 59 (PB7) — C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group'; '22 nF sampling cap are typical TSC values').

evidence.quote: Capacitive Touch Button (TSC) sheet: capacitor symbol C14 labelled '22p' wired from TSC_G2_IO4 to GND
C14 (22 nF to GND) — this is the TSC sampling capacitor for the group

anomalies.impact: The sampling capacitor is three orders of magnitude too small (22 pF instead of 22 nF). The STM32 TSC peripheral relies on Cx to integrate charge from the sense electrode; a 22 pF Cx is far below the recommended range, so the touch button's acquisition timing and charge accumulation will be wrong and the capacitive button will likely fail to detect touches or behave erratically.

parsed.summary: The board matches the specification on power rails, I2C pull-ups, OLED charge-pump/bias network, NFC antenna tuning, and the SWD header; the one deviation is C14, the TSC sampling capacitor, drawn as 22 pF instead of the intended 22 nF, which would break capacitive-touch sensing.
